trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
cat > "$tmp"

chmod 0644 "$tmp"
restorecon -F "$tmp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
mv -f "$tmp" "$dest"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
ANTRIEB_RECEIVER

touch /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 0600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
